profile.headline: Software Engineer at NextGear Capital
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer that has worked in multiple industries.  Over 20 years of experience as a full stack web application developer using Java, Javascript, relational and nosql databases, and several different UI frameworks.  A demonstrated history of working on project teams to deliver business value.  Experienced with Agile Scrum and other development project methodologies.  Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) focused in Computer Science from Indiana University Bloomington.
